warnings: revenue: 1 fiscal year(s) where the first-choice tag disagrees with the filed quarters (sum of four >5% apart, or a year below its own nine months) while another filed tag agrees — that tag is used (2018-12-31 RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax 1,603,306,000 → Revenues 4,225,761,000)

revenue basis: the filer's own total (Revenues / RevenuesNetOfInterestExpense) is used for 12 period(s) (2019-06-30, 2019-09-30, 2019-12-31, 2019-12-31, 2020-03-31, 2020-06-30, 2020-09-30, 2020-12-31, 2021-03-31, 2021-06-30, 2021-09-30, 2021-12-31) where it exceeds the contract-revenue line by >5% — the contract line is a component there

stock_issued: 3 derived quarter(s) (2013-09-30, 2015-12-31, 2018-09-30) came out negative — the fiscal-year (or year-to-date) figure and the leg subtracted from it are on different bases (a restatement, reclassification or discontinued operations); not shown
interest income: blank for 63 period(s) where the interest-expense figure is the filer's NET interest (income already inside it)

interest expense: the row mixes gross and NET figures, so it keeps the label "Interest expense"; net (income inside) for 51 period(s) 2013-12-31..2026-06-30 — including 17 filed under the gross tag whose value equals minus the filer's net interest tag for that period

quarters not derived (the year-to-date fact's tag has no shorter leg in the same tag: the 10-Qs carried the figure in another caption; flagged basis_break_quarterly): cost_of_revenue 2017-12-31, other_opex 2017-12-31, other_opex 2018-12-31, net_income_continuing 2009-12-31, net_income_continuing 2021-12-31, discontinued_ops 2009-12-31, discontinued_ops 2021-12-31, net_income_to_common 2009-12-31, capex_intangibles 2023-06-30, debt_issued 2013-09-30, debt_issued 2014-09-30, debt_issued 2015-06-30...

catch-all cash-flow quarters blanked (the two legs' filings present the section differently, so their difference is no filed figure; flagged basis_break_quarterly): other_financing 2021-06-30 (3,742,000 - 5,000,000; the longer leg's filing adds debt_issued, debt_repaid)

income statement: the operating lines shown for FY ending 2025-12-31 explain 3,079,480,000 of the 5,737,915,000 between revenue and operating income — the filer tags its other operating lines with custom elements that EDGAR companyfacts does not carry

restricted cash: in 9 period(s), 2023-06-30..2026-06-30 the cash line is the filed cash + restricted cash total (CashCashEquivalentsRestrictedCashAndRestrictedCashEquivalents, the cash-flow statement's total, read where the annual report filed no CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarryingValue for the date); in 9 period(s), 2023-06-30..2026-06-30 no figure separates the restricted part, so where those metrics are computed they still count restricted cash as cash (net cash overstated, net debt understated by the restricted amount; flagged incl_restricted_* and labelled 'some periods incl. restricted cash' on the metric; growth across a change between the two bases is blank)

free cash flow: 20 period(s) (2009-12-31..2019-12-31) report discontinued operations' investing cash flows on their own line, so capex is continuing-only there — FCF and owner's earnings use continuing OCF (NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActivitiesContinuingOperations, else OCF − CashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActivitiesDiscontinuedOperations from the same filing), blank where neither is filed; the OCF line itself stays the filed total
net margin: continuing net income ÷ revenue for 34 period(s) with discontinued operations (2009-12-31..2019-12-31) — revenue is continuing-only there

growth across filing generations: 65 annual growth cell(s) are blank because the year and the year before come from different filings that disagree (one restated by a later filing — discontinued operations, an accounting change, a recast — the other as originally filed; or a capex caption change): accounts_payable (2010-12-31); accrued (2010-12-31, 2018-12-31); acquisitions (2009-12-31); book_value_per_share (2010-12-31, 2013-12-31, 2018-12-31); capex (2009-12-31); capex_intangibles (2013-12-31, 2022-12-31); cash (2014-12-31); change_receivables (2009-12-31); current_lt_debt (2010-12-31); da (2009-12-31); deferred_revenue_current (2010-12-31, 2013-12-31); deferred_tax_assets (2013-12-31); ...
